changelog.notes: Polish on facilitator-mode (LP-014) per Copilot review: (1) both x402 endpoints (submit-mode and facilitator-mode) now reject Token-2022 mints (and any non-classic-SPL token) up front with a clear error before any vault USDC is spent - hardcoded TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID downstream would otherwise silently produce wrong ATAs and cryptic failures. Token-2022 support remains a future feature. (2) Service-fee math now uses the shared BPS_DENOMINATOR constant everywhere (was a stray `/ 10000n` in one spot, a drift risk if the on-chain constant ever changes). (3) OpenAPI spec for /v1/agent/actions/x402-facilitator now documents the 207 Multi-Status response for the `tx1_confirmed_tx2_build_failed` case so generated clients/docs are accurate.

Added facilitator-mode x402 via the new `pay_x402_facilitator` tool (POST /v1/agent/actions/x402-facilitator). LobsterPay now interoperates with spec-conformant x402 facilitator gateways (agonx402, Coinbase reference facilitator, etc.) that expect a pre-signed unsubmitted v0 transferChecked tx in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Implemented as a vault → relayer → facilitator two-tx passthrough: tx1 is execute_pay_exact(vault → relayer's USDC ATA, gross) with the normal 1.5% service fee to treasury; tx2 is a v0 transferChecked(relayer → facilitator's payTo, agonAmount) partial-signed by the relayer and returned to the agent for the retry. The facilitator's fee-payer pubkey is auto-extracted from `paymentRequirements.extra.feePayer` (no client-side field required). Relayer's USDC ATA is a per-call passthrough — no cross-user shared pool. Supersedes the v0.4.0 `compatibility` note that claimed PDAs couldn't interoperate with facilitators: the real constraint was envelope shape (needs `accepted` not `scheme`+`network` at top level) and tx shape (v0, compute-budget + transferChecked + memo in strict order) — both now handled server-side. No Anchor program changes.

x402 v2 envelope polish across the surface. (1) pay_x402's returned xPaymentHeader is now the spec's { x402Version: 2, scheme, network, payload: {...} } envelope instead of a flat object; payload carries both v2 field names (maxAmountRequired, payTo) and legacy aliases (amount, recipient) so upstream verifiers reading either still work. (2) The demo paywall at /v1/demo/x402/fortune and /v1/demo/x402/joke now emits v2-shaped 402 responses with { x402Version: 2, accepts: [{ scheme, network: 'solana:EtWTRABZaYq6iMfeYKouRu166VU2xqa1', maxAmountRequired, payTo, asset: { address, symbol, decimals }, ... }] }, and sends PAYMENT-REQUIRED / PAYMENT-RESPONSE headers alongside the legacy X-PAYMENT-* aliases. (3) Demo accepts both PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (v2) and X-PAYMENT (legacy) as the retry header. (4) Added an explicit `compatibility` section to the skill documenting the structural incompatibility with facilitator-style x402 gateways (agonx402, Coinbase reference) - their flow requires a pre-signed unsubmitted tx the facilitator submits, which vault PDAs cannot produce. [SUPERSEDED BY 0.5.0 — facilitator mode is now supported.]

pay_x402 now accepts CAIP-2 Solana chain identifiers in `paymentRequirements.network`, matching the x402 spec that real gateways (agonx402, etc.) emit. Accepted values: 'solana' (cluster-agnostic, resolves to the server's configured cluster), 'solana-devnet', 'solana-mainnet', 'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp' (CAIP-2 mainnet), 'solana:EtWTRABZaYq6iMfeYKouRu166VU2xqa1' (CAIP-2 devnet). Previously only plain 'solana' / 'solana-devnet' were accepted, which broke any agent that forwarded a real x402 gateway's 402 response intact. Cluster-specific values that don't match the server's cluster now return a precise 'Network mismatch' error instead of 'Unsupported network'. This deployment is on devnet; mainnet chain ids are rejected until a mainnet deployment exists.

pay_x402 is now fully on-chain. Previous versions only recorded x402 payment intents — the actual SPL transfer never submitted, so upstream API providers never got paid. The service now builds + submits an execute_pay_exact tx mirroring make_payment (pre-creates destination + treasury ATAs, enforces the policy on-chain, collects the 1.5% service fee, reimburses relayer gas from the vault's fee_vault PDA). Response shape gained xPaymentHeader — a base64-encoded JSON proof the agent SHOULD set as the X-PAYMENT header when retrying the original paywalled URL so the upstream API releases the content. Also added pending_confirmation status for tx-timeout cases (previously only confirmed/failed/duplicate).

Fixed execute_pay_exact failing with ConstraintMut (anchor error 2000): the backend instruction builder was passing the authority and fee_vault accounts as non-writable, but the on-chain program declares both as mut (authority receives reimbursement lamports, fee_vault has lamports debited). Also corrected the anchor error label map — 2000 is constraint_mut, not invalid_program_id.

make_payment now pre-creates the destination and treasury associated token accounts (ATAs) inside the same tx when they don't exist yet. Previously paying a wallet that had never held the mint failed with anchor_error_3012 (AccountNotInitialized). Uses the idempotent ATA-create variant so it's a no-op when accounts already exist. Also: agent error responses now map a wider range of anchor framework codes (2000–4100) to human-readable reason slugs, so agents see 'account_not_initialized' or 'constraint_seeds' instead of a bare number.

idempotencyKey is now optional on make_payment, execute_swap, and pay_x402 — the server auto-generates one per request. Most agents should simply omit the field. Provide an explicit key only when you want client-side retry safety (same key + same body = same outcome). Also: the backend now recovers from 'zombie' idempotency records (approved + persisted but no tx signature after 90s) — retries are no longer silently echoed a stuck 'created' status from a prior crashed attempt.

Fee model overhaul: the vault's on-chain fee_vault PDA now reimburses the tx fee payer after each agent action, so the vault economically pays its own gas. Users no longer need to manage a separate fee-payer keypair — deposit SOL into the fee_vault (via the dashboard) once and agent payments work indefinitely. New endpoint GET /v1/config/relayer returns the service relayer pubkey so frontends can auto-configure authorized_agent at vault creation. Anchor program upgraded in place: initialize_vault now accepts an optional authorized_agent param; execute_pay_exact reimburses the tx fee payer from fee_vault (bounded by FEE_REIMBURSEMENT_LAMPORTS = 10000, with rent-exempt guard). Existing vaults must call update_authorized_agent once to point at the service relayer.
check_vault now returns real on-chain token balances (previously always empty). Balances are an array of { mint, symbol, amount, uiAmount, decimals } filtered to non-zero holdings.
Skill files now served with real HTTPS API URL (no more {LOBSTERPAY_API_URL} placeholders or localhost defaults). Added versioning so agents can detect updates.
Initial release: check_vault, make_payment, get_swap_quote, execute_swap, pay_x402 tools.
